consumption.name: started
consumption.for: a principal began playing, reading or viewing a res

consumption.name: progressed
consumption.for: a principal's session reported a position within a res

consumption.name: completed
consumption.for: a position passed the ceiling spec-10 13.2 names for the category. Not reported by a client, so that a surface and a count cannot disagree about what finishing means

consumption.name: played
consumption.for: a principal played a res through. The scrobble a client reports on the OpenSubsonic surface, spec-07 6.6

consumption.name: read
consumption.for: a principal read a res whose category is not played, such as a letter or a comic issue

platform.name: acquired
platform.for: bytes entered the inbox and were recorded, spec-04 4

platform.name: placed
platform.for: an acquisition was placed in the catalog, spec-04 6

platform.name: normalized
platform.for: a holding gained its normalized master, spec-04 7

platform.name: verified
platform.for: an asset's bytes were read back and matched their digest, spec-03 4

platform.name: matched
platform.for: an external identifier or a corpus entry was equated with a res, spec-05 8

platform.name: corrected
platform.for: a member corrected what the deployment recorded, spec-01 7.5
